title: refactor(terraform): reshape state layout and unify GPU node pool / IAM / networking modules for private deployments
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Refactor state layout for private deployments, new gpu_node_pool module, consolidated IAM roles and networking output normalization. Includes migration helper script and docs. Backwards-compatible behavior preserved for existing customers but coordinated state migration required.
description:
Problem and motivation:
Redwood Private customers with multi-cluster/private VPC installs were running into brittle terraform state layout and duplication across environments (env-*/region-*). This made rollbacks, upgrades, and partial imports error-prone when adding GPU node pools or updating IAM roles.

What this PR does:
- Reshapes the terraform state layout into a predictable per-environment/per-cluster namespace (modules/state/*).
- Introduces a unified modules/gpu_node_pool that supports: GPU types (A100/V100), node taints, k8s labels, autoscaler config, and optional node-group rolling update strategy.
- Consolidates IAM into modules/iam with least-privilege role templates required for Private deployments (node role, admin role for installer, cross-account peering role).
- Normalizes networking outputs (vpc_id, subnet_* outputs) and adds explicit peering and route table attachment helpers for VPC peering use-cases in Private.
- Adds scripts/migrate_state.sh with automated terraform state mv/apply steps for the common migration path and a dry-run mode.
- Adds terratest for the node-pool module and updates examples/private-deploy to the new layout.

Migration notes (important):
- Existing installations require a coordinated upgrade window. See modules/state/README.md for exact terraform state mv commands. The provided migrate_state.sh automates the common migrations but teams must verify the dry-run before applying.
- This PR intentionally keeps legacy outputs for one release (aliases preserved) to allow a two-step upgrade. A follow-up cleanup PR will remove legacy aliases.

Testing and CI:
- Added terratest coverage for gpu_node_pool to exercise taint/label and autoscaler behavior.
- CI showed a flaky terratest run once; retried and passed. All linters/formatters pass.

Related work: ENG-4122 (state refactor for private), ENG-4198 (gpu autoscaling improvements).

Checklist:
- [x] reshape state layout and add migration helper
- [x] add gpu_node_pool module and tests
- [x] consolidate IAM roles and update docs
- [x] normalize networking outputs and add peering helpers
- [x] update examples and provide migration guide

Notes for reviewers:
- Please pay attention to modules/iam/roles.tf least-privilege changes; I added comments explaining rationale for each permission.
- The migrate_state.sh script includes a dry-run flag and prints exact terraform commands; prefer running with --dry-run in CI for your environment.

This PR is intentionally large; I recommend reviewing by commit. The squash merge preserves the migration helper and docs in the final commit.
commits: refactor(state): move existing resources into modules/state layout
feat(gpu): new modules/gpu_node_pool with autoscaling, taints, labels
refactor(iam): consolidate role templates and reduce permissions to least-privilege for installer/node roles
feat(networking): normalize outputs and add vpc peering helpers
chore(ci): add terratest for node_pool and fix flakey assertions
docs: add migration guide and examples update
review_comments: Diego Morales: Left a few comments around IAM scoping. Requesting explicit tests for the cross-account peering role — can we add a small unit/terratest that verifies policy document?
Ava Chen (author): Added tests for the peering role and expanded comments in modules/iam/roles.tf. Also added a note in modules/iam/README.md about cross-account trust boundaries.

Priya Nair: The migration script looks good but please add a dry-run safety net (already implemented) and a pointer to rollback steps. Also called out that we should keep legacy aliases for one release — agreed.
Liam O'Connor: Verified terratest behavior and CI flakiness; we should add a retry in CI for the terratest job (2 retries). I validated the plan output in a staging workspace.
Diego Morales: Approved after IAM comments addressed.
notes: Follow-up: cleanup legacy aliases (ENG-4175) and remove compatibility aliases after one release window. Schedule rotation for any pruned IAM policies with security team.
